name: Tuvalu
summary_text: Tuvalu demands real caution. Male same-sex conduct criminalised (14 years, unenforced); no LGR; very small, tight-knit, church-centred society; no specifically documented anti-trans violence (population ~11,000). Caveat: very small population — the evidence base is thin, so this assessment carries greater-than-usual uncertainty.

sources.claim_summary: ILGA World Database jurisdiction page for Tuvalu: documents the legal status — male same-sex conduct criminalised under colonial-era provisions.

sources.title: Human Dignity Trust
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Only the Human Dignity Trust homepage was retrievable at fetch time (no Tuvalu-specific page); the Trust maps jurisdictions criminalising LGBT people, which include Tuvalu.

US State Department 2013 Human Rights Report for Tuvalu: traditional customs perpetuate religious and social discrimination including against women; no government abuses; the LGBT section notes criminalisation under the Penal Code but no prosecutions.

Tuvalu Ministry of Health Global AIDS Progress Report 2017 (UNAIDS): the national HIV response, drawing on the Pacific Multi-Country Mapping and Behavioural Study on HIV and STI risk vulnerability among key populations (including MSM and transgender Tuvaluans).

sources.title: Over 80 Nations Support Statement at Human Rights Council on LGBT Rights - U.S. Mission to International Organizations in Geneva
sources.claim_summary: US Mission in Geneva (March 2011): post on LGBT rights in the UN context - Tuvalu was among Pacific countries signing the joint statement of support for decriminalisation and SOGI rights.

sources.title: Gay Tuvalu News & Reports
sources.claim_summary: GlobalGayz archive of Tuvalu news and reports: includes the OHCHR op-ed 'Decriminalizing Homosexuality - first step to establish equality' (Oct 2011) noting Tuvalu among Pacific countries supporting the UN call.
